description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.
ai_implications: Requires formal enterprise policy governing Large Language Model usage, acceptable prompting guidelines, and data classification boundaries.

description: Information security shall be integrated into project management throughout the project lifecycle.
ai_implications: Requires security gating, threat modeling, and model evaluation before deploying AI applications into production environments.

description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
ai_implications: Autonomous tool-calling agents must have restricted API scopes and cannot inherit unfettered administrative database or cloud permissions.

description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
ai_implications: All user access to AI agent interfaces and administrative consoles must mandate Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.
ai_implications: Mandates continuous adversarial prompt injection and jailbreak testing against LLM architectures and third-party AI APIs.

description: Data stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
ai_implications: Data privacy and right-to-be-forgotten controls in vector databases and fine-tuning datasets.

description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
ai_implications: LLM gateways and prompt firewalls must be placed at the ingress network perimeter to filter anomalous payloads.

description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
ai_implications: AI-generated source code and automated scripts must undergo static application security testing (SAST) and software bill of materials (SBOM) validation.
